input.encoding: numbers are normalised in double precision and stored as float16: bipolar10 and unipolar10 as x / 10, ratio and unit as x, qty as log1p(x) (signed log for degC), time (an age, hours since) as log1p(x), time_until (a deadline, hours until, negative = overdue) as a signed log1p, bool as 0 or 1; every number, word and pointer has a known flag (unknown is not zero, an empty list or 'nobody' is known); enum and word as vocabulary ids
input.pointer_encoding: an mref field holds the index of a token slot of the same decision (1..128); 0 = none (a known 'nobody', told apart from an unknown pointer by ptr_known); 129 + k = a GHOST: a record of the NPC's mind that this decision does not carry (k = 0..31, numbered by first appearance in the encoding order: rows, then columns, then proposition positions; two pointers to the same ghost give the same slot, two different ghosts give different slots); 161 = a ghost beyond the 32nd. A pointer to something the NPC's mind does not hold is refused (never encoded)

COMMIT.layout: counterparty (mref), mine_or_theirs, prop (expression), deadline_felt, status_believed, witnesses_believed

HEARD.layout: same fields as BELIEF (prop, polarity, certainty=engine prior, source=told, informant, hops, age)

INV.layout: same fields as THING (kind, props = object vector, state, amount, owner, file)

PLAN.layout: step (the current gesture), next (the gesture after it; '' = end of plan), goal (g:), target (mref), progress, commitment

WAKE.layout: why this decision happens now: mode, cause, trigger (the record that woke him), urgency

output.feasibility_mask: computed on the NPC's percepts and beliefs, never on the world; a gesture that the world refuses fails physically and that failure is perceived

writes.format: (target, variable, value); a structured value (proposition) comes from the speech decoder; creating a record = one write
